text:
maria: Heads up — the Go sample in /examples/sdk is using the wrong auth header name so people who copy/paste get 401s in prod. It uses `AuthorizationToken` instead of `Authorization` with `Bearer`. Anyone else run into this?
kevin: Yep saw one support ticket earlier today. Thought it was a secrets issue but it was the header name.
alex: That came from an old v0.9 snippet that got copied into the README. Current SDK expects: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — not `AuthorizationToken`.
jessica: Oof. While we're fixing that can we also update the retry behavior in the sample? The example retries POSTs blindly which can cause duplicate side-effects — we should show using an idempotency key or the SDK's retry helper.
kevin: Agreed. I'll put up a PR to: 1) fix header, 2) switch to SDK.retryWithBackoff helper, 3) add Idempotency-Key header for non-idempotent POSTs.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inc/examples/pull/824 (kevin)
maria: Also noticed the README code block has curly “smart” quotes around the curl token — that breaks copy/paste in terminals. Need straight quotes in the markdown.
alex: Here's a tiny before/after to paste into the PR description so reviewers can eyeball it:
```
# BEFORE (broken)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "AuthorizationToken: abc123" -d '{“prompt”: "hello"}'

# AFTER (fixed)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer abc123" -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -d '{"prompt": "hello"}'
```
jessica: Nice. Can we also add a tiny CI lint that checks for `AuthorizationToken` and smart quotes in markdown? Simple grep as a pre-merge check.
kevin: I'll add a short GH Action that fails the PR if those patterns are found. Also will update the JS sample so SDK parity is maintained — don't want JS and Go drifting.
maria: Assigning to @kevin and @alex to handle the patch + parity check. Can someone also add a short note to the onboarding checklist so new hires don't copy the legacy snippet?
alex: Will do. I'll add a checklist item and a unit test that validates samples build and the curl examples contain `Authorization: Bearer`.
docs-bot: Issue created for parity work: https://github.com/redwood-inc/internal/issues/1421
maria: Great — timeline? Can we get this into next patch release (target next Tuesday)?
kevin: Yes, I'll aim to land PR + action by Monday EOD. If anyone spots other copy/paste quirks ping me.
jessica: Thanks all. Small, fast wins for DX. :thumbsup:
kevin: :+1:
alex: pushed a tiny commit in the PR to replace smart quotes and update the example to use the SDK helper.
maria: Awesome, closing the loop here. If support sees more 401s we'll reference PR #824 in replies.
